scientific_integrity: The all-dimensional theorem is proved analytically; exact arithmetic finite checks are corroborative, not an infinite certificate. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to noncyclic alternating adjacent-sum polytopes with integer s>=1 and dimension d>=2. The s=1 even product relaxation and the Fibonacci independent-set recurrence are known ingredients. The motivating complete manuscript could not be inspected; historical priority is provisional.
title: Fibonacci contact rigidity and exact diametral pairs of alternating adjacent-sum polytopes
